name: Appartments Panorama
beschreibung: Appartments Panorama is a hotel accommodation in Tyrol, Austria. The property offers guests several self-catering apartments. The units are equipped with a living area, a kitchenette, and a bathroom. Its setting in the Tyrolean mountains provides easy access to hiking and cycling trails. In winter, the nearby ski areas serve as popular destinations. Some units feature a balcony or terrace with mountain views. Paid parking is available on site.
